snippet.title: ANARIA: Reborn – Psychological Horror Game | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the fractured mind of a girl haunted by fear, memories, and something far darker than reality itself.

🕯️ ANARIA: Reborn is a story-driven psychological horror where you awaken inside a mysterious house with no memory of who you are. Every shadow hides a secret, every sound could betray you, and something… is always watching.

💀 Key Features

Manipulate time to uncover clues and navigate twisted spaces

Evade a relentless doll pursuer that reacts to your every move

Experience cinematic storytelling and scripted horror events

Explore, solve puzzles, and piece together a haunting mystery

🎮 Wishlist ANARIA: Reborn on Steam 👇
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3924150/ANARIA_Reborn/

If you love psychological horror and cinematic experiences, this game is for you.
